name: Card / Deckbuilder
description: The deckbuilder pack: draw a hand, spend a per-turn energy budget, play cards whose effects are pure data, then grow and refine the deck through post-combat drafts. The pack treats the deck as run-scoped inventory rather than a new subsystem — inventory.core_inventory owns the collection, inventory.deck_manager owns the piles, and the division is deliberate: cards you own and cards you drew this turn are different facts with different lifetimes. Effects route through utility.command_bus and resolve through the existing combat kit, so a deckbuilder built on this pack gets damage, status, and rejection semantics for free and only has to design cards.
loop: draw hand → spend energy → play cards → reward draft → thin/refine deck

signatureCompound.name: One Combat, One Draft
signatureCompound.description: A single encounter that proves the loop: deck_manager draws the opening hand from a seeded shuffle, energy_per_turn refills and refuses, card_effect_dsl resolves two plays through damage_resolver and status_effects, a relic fires off combat.turnStarted, the enemy falls, and draft_reward_screen offers three cards — the player takes one, and it is in the deck for the next fight.
